description: This PHP source file defines an abstract class 'LeaveStatusChange' in the 'OrangeHRM\Leave\Event' namespace. The class models an event related to changes in leave request statuses within the OrangeHRM HRM system, encapsulating leaves, workflow state, and the user performing the action.

classes.name: LeaveStatusChange
classes.description: An abstract event class representing a change in leave status, containing leaves, workflow, and performer information.

methods.name: getLeaves
methods.description: Returns the array of leave requests related to this event.

methods.name: getWorkflow
methods.description: Returns the workflow state machine associated with the leave change.

methods.name: getPerformer
methods.description: Returns the user who performed the leave status change.
